note: Files are byte-identical to the originals (sha256 recorded when moved). They are not functional research-intelligence engines.

files.why: Every method returns fixed text (invented research questions, a 'p < 0.001' statistic, a fixed figure list) whatever paper it is given.
'5-pass pipeline' returns one fixed dictionary (Hardware-Aware Sparse Tensor Engine, 95.3% accuracy, 12.4 ms) for any title or text.
Methodology, results, figure and contribution 'agents' return fixed values (learning rate 3e-4, 95.3% vs 92.1%) and never read the text argument.
'Knowledge graph' of 15 fixed entities and two fixed claims (confidence 98, replication_count 7) independent of the paper.
Returns a fixed three-section 'review' of invented prose plus four fixed references; the paper count is just echoed.
Returns fixed 'weekly updates' with invented papers and DOIs, dated 2026-07-28 and 2026-07-21.
Returns a fixed reading trajectory and a fixed recommendation with an invented 'comprehension gain 30% -> 85%'.
Returns a fixed 'evidence quality score 91/100' with invented counts of studies and a fixed benchmark table for any question.
Section parser is a keyword router; tables, equations, knowledge graph, reasoning and podcast script are fixed text (invented tables, fixed equations, 'is_sota: Yes').
QLoRA script that, when its dataset file is missing, writes and trains on one invented sample record; no held-out set, no evaluation, no licence record.
